t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Often a colour is indicative of the yield, so it seems that if you select that colour and it yields 0, then it will do for the next couple of rounds too. Make use of the breaks provided, and remember 1.5 seconds goes quickly!

vb_textbox.text: There will always be either a Yellow, Green, Orange or Blue troll. I have found selecting these consistently the best method for higher yields. I messed around for ages over the taller vs smaller Green > Pink > Blue and couldn't find any consistency in what scored better. Particularly on x5 rounds the Y/G/O/B method worked best for me. 1.5 seconds is fast too so don't get complacent. I actually found skipping the breaks easier as I could just continue in my method .
